value.rationale: The theorem identifies a complete, unique global placement law for a natural nonlinear stochastic integral observed through noisy planar path knots. The unexpected nonmonotone response is characterized by an exact algebraic turning point and strict departures from noiseless trisection. It is useful as a quantitative sparse-sensing benchmark even though the gain is small; no generic SDE convergence improvement is claimed.
